title: A rate-limited provider no longer fails a mission's discovery that found papers
user_story: As the owner I want a mission's discovery step to keep the papers the other providers returned when one provider is rate limited, and to say which provider did not answer (live run 2026-10-28, OpenAlex 429; agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md A7).

requirements.description: A partial discovery job that found papers completes the paper.discover step with partial=true, the provider errors and a limitation naming them.
A discovery that found nothing still fails, naming the provider errors; downloads stay strict.

nonfunctional: No retry loop against a rate-limited provider

scenarios.expected: 3 arXiv papers kept; partial; 'openalex: HTTP 429' in errors and limitations
A complete discovery is not marked partial
Zero papers with a 429 fails and names it
The failure message carries the provider errors
The missing provider is reported, never hidden
The rate-limited provider is asked once

recovery: Fix at the paper.discover handler; never hide a provider error or accept an empty partial. TASK-DISCOVERY-PARTIAL-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR with a real topic, jobs and mission; the real provider wrapper with provider HTTP calls replaced; evidence in docs/qa/evidence/discovery-partial-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 4 tests on 981b7fc, all failing (partial discovery failed the step; no partial flag). GREEN: 4/4.
